title: frasera albomarginata var. induta
intro: Frasera albomarginata var. induta, commonly known as White Sagebrush, is a plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. Frasera albomarginata var. induta contains bioactive constituents such as iridoids, triterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
